history.title: EPAA 29(100) document analysis (Leider, Colombo & Nerlino, 2021)
history.description: Leider, Colombo & Nerlino published in Education Policy Analysis Archives 29(100) a comprehensive document analysis of every state and DC's bilingual, ELD/ESL, and SEI teacher-credentialing requirements, professional teaching standards mentions, and EL-percentage figures, based on primary SEA sources collected October–December 2019. The 2019 coding of South Dakota's EL-credentialing landscape is preserved as a temporally-anchored research baseline against which the catalog's later verifications are framed.

history.title: Silver and Gold Seal of Biliteracy program launched
history.description: South Dakota implemented the Silver and Gold State Seal of Biliteracy in 2024 — among the most recent statewide adoptions, with two performance levels (Silver intermediate, Gold advanced).

elPercentHistory.note: South Dakota Department of Education, last-Friday-in-September snapshot (4,230 EL students of 141,467 enrolled, hosted via the Associated School Boards of South Dakota). The figure is approximately 1.6 percentage points below NCES's fall 2021 value (4.6%); the cause is unclear from publicly available sources and could reflect a methodology change, a definitional refinement, or a genuine population decline. Without a SEA-published multi-year series, methodological continuity with the prior NCES series cannot be confirmed.
